notes: Identity independently checked: matching title (L70–72), authors Alldredge, Burlingame, Olsen, Van Epps (L74–80), DOI 10.1037/gdn0000121 (L198), journal/year. Full primary research report frozen as ResearchGate numbered text parse, including Method, Results, Discussion, Conclusions and References; advance pagination differs from final pagination. No PDF supplied. Provenance explicitly says equals signs are rendered as !; operators interpreted accordingly, quotes retain canonical glyphs. Original is an unassigned placeholder. 5,493 individual-only clients + 146 group-only clients = 5,639 clients, from mutually exclusive final groups in the critical rate table; not recruitment N or df. Matched by frequency outcome and chi-square test, independently of input order; supplied p.8 locator is offset from advance p.7 rate test. The separate relative risk 1.43 has p=.004, and Cramer’s V=.04 is also printed; requested test statistic retained with same-test p=.007. Limitations L1960 calls 46 clients group-only; Table 1 explicitly distinguishes 146 total from 46 who alerted, so table roles retained.
